title: Koushite Karera no Machigatta Seishun ga Hajimaru.
Kitto, Dareshimo Hitoshi Nami ni Nayami wo Kakaeteiru.
Tamani Rabu Kome no Kami-sama wa ii Koto wo Suru.
Tsumari, Kare wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai.
Mata Shite mo, Kare wa Moto Kita Michi e Hikikaesu.
Youyaku Kare to Kanojo no Hajimari ga Owaru.
Tomoare, Natsuyasuminanoni Yasumenai no wa Nanikaokashii.
Izure Karera Kanojora wa Shinjitsu wo Shiru.
Mitabi, Kare wa Moto Kita Michi e Hikikaesu.
Izentoshite Karera no Kyori wa Kawarazu ni, Matsuri wa Mousugu Carnival.
Soshite, Sorezore no Butai no Maku ga Agari, Matsuri wa Saikou ni Festival tte Iru.
Koushite, Kare to Kanojo to Kanojo no Seishun wa Machigai Tsudzukeru.
